sentences.en: It is unlikely that this indictment will lead to his deportation.
sentences.zh: 这项起诉书不太可能导致他的被驱逐。

sentences.en: The family name fell into disrepute following their son's federal indictment.
sentences.zh: 他们的儿子遭到联邦起诉后，这个家族的名字便声名狼藉了。

sentences.en: The prosecutor presented the evidence for the indictment at the preliminary hearing.
sentences.zh: 检察官在预审听证会上提出了起诉书的证据。

senses.zh: 指控，控告；谴责，不满；（制度、社会等的）衰败迹象，腐败迹象；诉状，公诉书
